probe_model_activations: use AutoProbeD as a context manager to probe and log a PyTorch model's activations and gradients
log_tensor_stats: use log_stats to manually log a named tensor's statistics during model probing
compute_tensor_statistics: use _get_stats to compute mean, std, skew, kurtosis, quantiles, min, and max for a tensor
mask_attention_logits: use _mask_attn_logits to apply causal and block diagonal masking to attention logits
disable_torch_compile: use TorchCompileDisabler as a context manager to temporarily disable torch compile on a module
